data.text: Kate, I support 10 tons each and will choose 10 if we all agree. Equal shares give each of us $10,000 a month while keeping the lake full, rather than risking future income over a few extra tons now. If anyone exceeds the agreement, let’s discuss how to restore the stock and adjust catches afterward—not retaliate by emptying the lake. John, would you support 10 each? Emma and Luke, can you accept equal shares?
